full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg., cor EDSA Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 69 S. May 27, 2010 EDUARDO M. DE GUZMAN Punong Barangay 150 Zone 13 District II, Manila Dear PB De Guzman: 2010 This is in response to your letter seeking the legal opinion of this Department on issues involving the authority of the sanggunian to remove barangay elective officials. In response thereto, please be informed that we have squarely addressed the issue in DILG Opinion No. 33, series of 2010, dated 18 March 2010. In the aforesaid legal opinion, we opined that an elective official may be removed from office only by order of the proper court. Hence the sangguniang bayan cannot render a decision imposing upon a certain elective barangay official the penalty of removal for such decision is null and void for having been rendered without authority in law. A photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion is hereto attached for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: A Legal:28/corz . JESUS . DOQU DirectOr II
